subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after_compaction hooks gain a core current-session reset capability, and if so should the public contract contain only resetSession(reason?) with no explicit-key compatibility overload?
rationale: This creates a new external plugin capability that can rotate persisted session state across several runtime owners; repository policy requires maintainer intent rather than inferring a permanent API from an unmerged predecessor PR.

options.title: Approve narrow scoped API
options.body: Keep only resetSession(reason?), remove unrelated behavior, and require lifecycle-owner review plus complete real-runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep recovery plugin-owned
options.body: Do not add a core hook API and require the motivating integration to use an existing plugin-owned recovery or gateway seam.

options.title: Sponsor both signatures
options.body: Explicitly accept the reason-only and same-key overload as a permanent plugin contract with compatibility tests and documentation.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow scoped API
recommendation.body: Keep only resetSession(reason?), remove unrelated behavior, and require lifecycle-owner review plus complete real-runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about the compaction lifecycle boundary and its safe post-run ownership.
